This game is incredibly fun and a great update to the original game. I got the original when it came out and, honestly, I did not really like it. It felt pretty limited, the controls were a struggle and the only way to do multiplayer being the hellspawn that was Himachi really just wasn't fun for me. Since then I got Risk of Rain 2 and loved it, even 100% the game and its one of my favorites, so seeing this game I felt I had to give it another try and it is so much better. Don;t get me wrong there are still some problems here and there, but the game is much more fleshed out and polished, multiplayer connections are built in and stable, the game has very few actual bugs. That doesn't sound like much, but considering how games companies are today, it was such a breeze of fresh air. The couple problems with the game (stuff like climbing ropes feeling janky or some of the Trials being imbalanced in different ways) I have confidence that Hopoo Games will be fix those quickly the same way they were very hands on with Risk of Rain 2.
